title: Zap Kits
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that lets you save and instantly load complete inventory setups using simple commands.
body:
# Zap Kits – Save & Load Inventories Instantly ⚡

Tired of rebuilding the same inventory setup over and over? Zap Kits is a lightweight Fabric mod that lets you save, load, preview, and manage complete inventory loadouts with simple commands. Perfect for builders, content creators, server staff, map makers, and players who frequently switch between different setups.

## Key Features

* Save complete inventories, including hotbar, armor, offhand, and inventory contents
* Instantly load saved kits whenever you need them
* Preview kits before loading them
* Easy kit management with simple commands
* Persistent storage across game restarts
* Lightweight and performance-friendly
* Perfect for creative building, testing, recordings, and administration

## Commands

### Save a Kit

`/zkit save <name>`

### Load a Kit

`/zkit load <name>`

### Preview a Kit

`/zkit preview <name>`

### List All Kits

`/zkit list`

### Delete a Kit

`/zkit delete <name>`

## Note

To load a kit, you must have access to Creative Mode, whether in a single-player world or on a multiplayer server. However, you can still save, preview, list, and delete your kits regardless of your current game mode.

All saved kits are stored locally and remain available after restarting Minecraft, making it easy to back up, transfer, or share your favorite loadouts.

## Why Zap Kits?

Whether you're creating content, building large projects, testing maps, or managing a server, Zap Kits eliminates the hassle of manually recreating inventories. Save once, load anytime, and stay focused on what matters.
